scope: Concept images only. Existing refers to a gallery form, not a screenshot or pixel-exact implementation. New concepts are unimplemented.

images.title: Cover Flow
images.visual: 中央横向十图拼版、两侧透视封面、长倒影与三级时间线。
images.implementation: 已有活动封面、有效评分 Top10、目录年月；连续滚动与原地返回继续复用。
images.boundary: 概念图的导航、边框和文字仅作示意；正式版以当前交互及响应式研究为准。
images.prompt: Refine the attached Cover Flow concept. Preserve its pure black / ochre visual language, realistic fictional travel photographs, navigation and delicate reflections. CRITICAL CHANGE: the central ten-photo activity cover must be a WIDE LANDSCAPE RECTANGLE with exact 3:2 aspect ratio, approximately 690px wide by 460px tall within a 1600x1000 composition, horizontally centered. It must not be a portrait poster. Rear covers use the same LANDSCAPE 3:2 mosaic proportion in perspective, four on each side with ample spacing, central cover strictly front facing. Keep a narrow three-level year/month/activity timeline at far right. Long reflections fade into black, with correct occlusion and moderate brightness. Bottom caption only '2024 · 10' and '海边的一天', centered, arrows at far left/right bottom. Main board mosaic: one large seaside family photo, nine smaller photos arranged in a coherent asymmetrical landscape grid. Preserve the quality of the photographs. No additional text, logos, slogans, borders around the page, browser chrome or device frame.

images.title: 活动照片墙
images.visual: 保留照片原比例的横向瀑布流，以内容密度呈现活动全过程。
images.implementation: 复用活动分页、4K预览、按拍摄时间排序、单图暗房。
images.boundary: 图中日期、128张及视频数量均为虚构示例，不是本库统计。

A single beautiful horizontally scrolling waterfall masonry gallery for one seaside activity, natural ORIGINAL ASPECT RATIOS of 14–18 distinct photographs: wide landscapes, upright portraits, panoramic sea, family candids, lighthouse details, food, streets. Photos form 3 staggered horizontal masonry rows at different widths, very narrow 4px black gutters; the photo river continues beyond right edge, clearly horizontal, not a uniform square grid and not a card dashboard. Composition fills almost entire width and height below navigation, no overlapping photographs. Top left small back arrow. Bottom left a compact HORIZONTAL caption '海边的一天' then thin ochre vertical divider then '128 张照片 · 3 个视频', one row, small date above. Tiny translucent play triangle on one video cover. images.implementation: 复用effective拍摄时间及日期精度；目录只有年/月时不伪造日。
images.boundary: 生成日期格与数量不作为日历算法验收；必须由真实数据渲染。

images.title: 人生年轮
images.purpose: 看见整部照片集的时间跨度
images.visual: 年份化作同心照片环，旋转或选择一环，展开其中活动。
images.implementation: 第一版按年分桶，每环只选少量代表缩略图，右侧展开活动；SVG裁切或局部WebGL实现。
images.boundary: 年份有据、月份缺失保留未知；不要用照片密度推断人生幸福或填补缺失年月。

images.title: 记忆星图
images.visual: 主体、风格、匿名人物组形成照片群；选中一张，沿关联继续探索。
images.implementation: 先用现有主体/style/topic和人工人物组聚合；相似度连线若需要向量，新增本地embedding provider与版本索引。
images.boundary: 连线需能解释依据与置信度；候选标签不冒充事实，不运行外部人脸识别，不自动建立真实社会关系。

images.visual: 跨年份与活动混排，主图、细节和留白形成一段横向叙事。

images.boundary: 章节标题可人工编辑；不生成未经用户确认的人生事实。与整场活动密集照片墙用途不同。
